elements.element: Mutual aggregate cap using a greater-of structure
elements.evidence: each Party's total aggregate liability ... shall not exceed the greater of (A) ... and (B) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000)

elements.element: Fee limb measured as fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim — an event anchor, not 'preceding the claim'
neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for confidentiality, data protection and security breaches
elements.evidence: "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud
elements.evidence: its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: The Company's obligations to pay amounts due under Section 3 and Section 4.2 are not subject to the foregoing limitations — an exclusion from the cap limited to two sections, not a statement that payment obligations are not damages

elements.element: Mutual cap of at least 12 months' fees
elements.evidence: shall not exceed the greater of (A) the fees paid or payable by the Company ... in the twelve (12) months
breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations

elements.element: Carve-out for gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud

reasons: The inserted clause is a concise, self-contained limitation of liability for a document that had none, and it leaves the existing Globix warranty paragraph untouched — minimality and intent are preserved.

Two preferred elements fall short: the fee limb is anchored to 'the event giving rise to the claim' rather than the 12 months 'preceding the claim', and the payment-obligation sentence is drafted as a carve-out from the cap for amounts under Sections 3 and 4.2 rather than a statement that Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes.

Recommended fix without expanding the clause: replace 'immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim' with 'immediately preceding the claim', and replace the final sentence with 'The Company's obligations to pay amounts due under this Agreement are not "damages" for purposes of the foregoing limitations.'

All required carve-outs, the mutual indirect-damages exclusion and the USD 1,000,000 limb are present, so the clause comfortably clears the fallback and sits above it; the shortfalls are wording-precision points to note in the rationale rather than material deviations.
